name: sale_order_line_price_history
summary: Lets a salesperson see the past prices charged for a product from a sale order line, using a clock button on the line. From the pop-up they can copy one of those old prices back onto the line. The number of lines shown and whether quotations or the customer's commercial entity are included can be configured.

name: sale_order_line_price_lock_by_pricelist
summary: Stops salespeople from editing the unit price or discount on a sale order line when the price comes from a locking pricelist rule. Each pricelist sets whether all products, a product category, or a single product is locked. Sales managers are not locked, so they can still change those prices.

name: sale_order_line_product_attribute_values
summary: Stores product attribute values, such as a trademark or size, on each sale order line so lines can be viewed and filtered by them. It is a search and reporting aid on the sales order lines. Existing lines are updated through a scheduled action rather than during install.

name: sale_order_line_remove
summary: Lets users delete a sale order line from a confirmed order, but only if that line has not been invoiced or delivered. A setting in the Sales configuration turns this on. It is useful for correcting a confirmed order without cancelling the whole thing.

name: sale_order_line_sequence
summary: Adds a line number to sale order lines so they keep a fixed order, and shows that number on sale order reports. The line number also carries over to customer invoice lines. It is a presentation feature for quotes and orders with many lines.

name: sale_order_line_stock_move_history
summary: Adds a button on each sale order line that opens the stock move history for that line's product. It appears next to the Delivered field, so a user can see how stock has moved while reviewing an order. Nothing else on the order changes.

name: sale_order_line_tag
summary: Lets users attach classification tags to individual sale order lines, for example to record why a line exists. The tags are a shared list defined in the system and appear on the line in the sales order. Useful for grouping or reporting on line types.

name: sale_order_lot_generator
summary: Automatically creates a lot number for each sale line when the sale order is confirmed, for products flagged to auto-generate lots. The flag is set on the product's Inventory tab. Use it when products are lot-tracked and staff should not type lot numbers by hand.

name: sale_order_lot_selection
summary: Lets salespeople choose the specific lot or serial number on a sale order line, so that exact lot is the one delivered to the customer. Delivery orders reserve that lot when it is in stock. A company setting can exclude lots already tied to pending orders from the choice.

name: sale_order_lot_selection_price
summary: Lets a sale price (or cost) be set on each lot, so an order line using that lot is priced from the lot's value plus any pricelist discount. It is set up with a formula-based pricelist. Use it when different lots of the same product sell at different prices.

name: sale_order_note_template
summary: Adds reusable terms and conditions templates that can be picked on a sale order, and turns the terms field into rich text. Templates are written with Jinja2 so they can fill in order details. Use it to avoid retyping standard terms on every quotation.

name: sale_order_payment_terms_from_invoice_address
summary: Changes where a sale order takes its payment terms from: the invoice address instead of the customer. Turn on the setting under Sales settings and the Payment Terms field on new orders follows the invoice contact. It does not change how screens look.

name: sale_order_price_recalculation
summary: Adds two buttons under the sale order lines: one recalculates all line prices from the current pricelist, and one resets product descriptions from the product record. Both overwrite earlier manual changes on those lines, so they run only when the salesperson chooses. Handy after changing a pricelist or duplicating an order.

name: sale_order_priority
summary: Adds a priority field to sale orders and their lines. An order's priority is the highest priority among its lines, and setting it on the order sets all its lines. The priority carries through to the procurement, stock moves and delivery picking created on confirmation.

name: sale_order_product_assortment
summary: Limits the products a salesperson can add to a sale order based on the customer's product assortment. Products on the allowed list can be added, and products on the restricted list are blocked. Assortments are defined with the product_assortment module, and the customer field can be changed with a system parameter.

name: sale_order_product_availability_inline
summary: Shows each product's free-to-use stock quantity in the product dropdown on a sale order line. A salesperson can see whether an item is in stock before choosing it. It needs the Sales and Inventory apps.

name: sale_order_product_recommendation
summary: Adds a Recommended Products wizard to a sale order that suggests products the customer has recently bought, based on delivered sales. The salesperson picks items from the list and adds them to the order in one step. Prices can come from the list price or the customer's last sale price.

name: sale_order_product_recommendation_elaboration
summary: Extends sale order product recommendations so elaborations (customer-specific details or customizations) can be repeated from the customer's last order for a product, or entered when a recommended product is added. Depends on the sale_elaboration module. Use it when product lines need extra detail beyond the product itself.

name: sale_order_product_recommendation_packaging_default
summary: Adds packaging and packaging quantity columns to the recommended products wizard, so a salesperson can add recommendations by package size. Product packagings must be turned on in Sales settings. Use it when products are sold by box or case.

name: sale_order_product_recommendation_secondary_unit
summary: Adds the secondary unit of measure to the recommended products wizard, so quantities can be entered in a second unit such as cases or pallets. The secondary unit only appears for products that have one set for sales. It builds on the product recommendations wizard.

name: sale_order_qty_change_no_recompute
summary: Stops a sale line's manual discount and pricelist rule from being reset when only the quantity or unit of measure changes. Without it, changing the quantity recalculates the discount and wipes a negotiated one. Use it when customers have a fixed discount that should survive quantity edits.

name: sale_order_report_without_price
summary: Adds a print option that produces quotation and order PDFs without prices. Use it when sending a document that lists products but should not show amounts. It is chosen from the print menu on the quotation or order.

name: sale_order_requested_delivery
summary: Adds requested delivery start and end date fields to sale orders and their lines, so the customer's preferred delivery window is recorded. The window is shown as a combined period on the order. Use it to capture a date range rather than a single delivery date.

name: sale_order_restrict_copy_archived_product
summary: Blocks duplicating a sale order when it contains archived products, and lists which products are archived. This stops archived items from being quietly copied into new orders. The check runs when the Duplicate action is used on the order.

name: sale_order_revision
summary: Keeps track of revised quotations. A cancelled order gets a New Copy of Quotation button that creates a numbered revision, with a chatter note and a tab listing past revisions. Old revisions are archived so they do not clutter searches.

name: sale_order_secondary_unit
summary: Lets salespeople enter sale quantities in a product's secondary unit of measure, such as cases or boxes, and the base quantity updates to match. Secondary units are defined on the product with a conversion factor. Use it when customers order in a different unit than you stock or invoice.

name: sale_order_show_currency_rate
summary: Adds a box to sale order PDF reports showing the exchange rate between the order currency and the company currency, along with the order date. The box appears only when the currencies differ and a rate is available. A company setting chooses the reference currency.

name: sale_order_split_strategy
summary: Lets you define split rules that separate one sale order into several orders, for example when some lines need a different carrier or temperature handling. Each strategy uses a saved filter on order lines, and a Split button on the order applies it. Useful for webshop or EDI orders that mix shipping needs.

name: sale_order_tag
summary: Adds tags to sale orders for classifying them, separate from CRM opportunities. Tags can carry a colour and can be limited to specific sales teams. They are added on the order form.

name: sale_order_team_from_product
summary: Sets the sales team on a quotation automatically from the sales teams defined on its products. If every product shares one team, that team goes on the quote. A setting can skip this when a team is already chosen. It depends on the product_sale_team module.

name: sale_order_transmit_method
summary: Adds a transmission method, such as email, post or portal, to sale orders and carries it through to the invoices. It records how the document should be sent to the customer. It depends on the invoice transmit method module.

name: sale_order_type
summary: Adds sale order types, such as lines of business, each with its own journal, warehouse, sequence, shipping and invoicing policy, payment terms, pricelist and incoterm. Choosing a type on an order fills in all those settings, and a customer can have a default type. It also warns when the customer's pricelist differs from the type's pricelist.

name: sale_order_type_confirm_message
summary: Shows a confirmation pop-up with a custom message before a quotation is confirmed, when its order type has one set. The user must press Confirm in the pop-up to continue. Use it to warn about special terms for certain kinds of orders.

name: sale_order_warehouse_header
summary: Moves the warehouse field up into the header of the sale order form, so it is easier to find. The search view also gets filter and group-by options for warehouse. It shows on the Sales order form and in order search.

name: sale_order_warn_message
summary: A small technical extension that adds a warning message field to sale orders and shows it as a popup. It makes sure the warning is filled in, not only when the customer changes. It appears on the sales order form.

name: sale_packaging_default
summary: Makes packaging easier on sales by moving the packaging fields in front of the quantity, and auto-filling a product's default sales packaging when it is picked. The first packaging enabled for sales is the default. It can also make packaging mandatory when a product has sales packagings.

name: sale_partner_address_restrict
summary: Limits the delivery and invoice address choices on a sale order to addresses that belong to the selected customer. A checkbox on an address marks it as a dropship address, which keeps the buyer's name off the delivery address. The restriction is turned on in Sales settings.

name: sale_partner_incoterm
summary: Sets a default incoterm (shipping terms) on each customer's Sales and Purchases tab, and allows a different one per contact within the same company. New quotations for that customer pick up the incoterm automatically. The order also gets an incoterm address.

name: sale_partner_order_template
summary: Lets you set an order template on each customer, so a new order for that customer is pre-filled from the template. The template is chosen in the Sales section of the customer record. Use it for customers who regularly buy the same set of products.

name: sale_partner_primeship
summary: Adds time-limited prime memberships to customers. Confirming a sale order with a membership product activates the membership for a set number of months, and it expires automatically. Customers show their current membership status on their record and can be filtered by it.

name: sale_partner_selectable_option
summary: Lets you mark a contact as not selectable on sale orders, so it will not appear in the Customer field. The default for new contacts can be changed with a system parameter. Use it to keep certain contacts off orders while still keeping them in the database.

name: sale_partner_shipping_default_partner_invoice
summary: Sets the invoice address on a sale order from the shipping address, using a Default Invoice Address on the customer record. When the shipping address is chosen, the invoice address follows. It is set up on the partner form.

name: sale_payment_sheet
summary: Lets salespeople record customer payments on a payment sheet without needing accounting rights. The sheet can be tied to specific invoices and, once confirmed, creates a bank statement for accounting. The journals a user can pay into are set on the user record.

name: sale_planner_calendar
summary: Lets sales reps plan recurring customer visits as calendar events, created from a smart button on the partner. A planner screen shows what each rep has to do today, and visits can be reassigned through a wizard. Settings control how far ahead visits are generated and whether attendees get invitations.

name: sale_pricelist_display_surcharge
summary: Makes a pricelist rule always show a surcharge on the customer's document, instead of only showing discounts that benefit the customer. The Show Surcharge option is set on the pricelist rule. Use it when a rule adds cost and the increase should be visible.

name: sale_pricelist_from_commitment_date
summary: Uses the order's delivery (commitment) date, instead of the order date, to pick the pricelist price for each line. It also lets you show the Delivery Date in the order header and make it mandatory, both set in Sales settings. Use it when prices depend on when goods will be delivered.

name: sale_pricelist_packaging
summary: Adds packaging to pricelist rules, so the same product can sell at different prices depending on the packaging chosen. Use it when a case is priced differently per unit than a single item. The packaging is set on the pricelist rule.

name: sale_probability_amount
summary: Adds a win probability to quotations. New quotes start at 50%, drop to 0% when cancelled and go to 100% when confirmed. The quotation list can total the expected amount in company currency, which gives a simple sales pipeline view.

name: sale_procurement_group_by_line
summary: A technical base module that gives each sale order line its own procurement group, so other modules can route lines separately. On its own it changes nothing visible to users. Other modules that create per-line procurement build on it.

name: sale_product_identification
summary: Requires an identification document, such as an authorisation or proof of age, before certain restricted products can be sold to a customer. Products get identification categories that are mandatory or optional, set on the product's Sales tab. It builds on the partner_identification module.

name: sale_product_multi_add
summary: Adds a button on a sale order that opens a wizard to add many products and quantities at once. Use it to fill a large order quickly instead of adding one line at a time. The wizard adds the chosen items as order lines.

name: sale_product_set
summary: Lets a sales manager define product sets, which are fixed lists of products with quantities, that salespeople can add to a quotation in one step through a wizard. Each set line becomes a separate order line that can be edited afterwards. Use it for standard bundles that the customer does not see as one product.

name: sale_product_set_packaging_qty
summary: Lets product set lines use packagings and packaging quantities, so a set can state how many cases it includes. It is a small add-on with no new fields of its own, and it works alongside product sets and stock.

name: sale_production_state
summary: Shows the manufacturing state on sale orders and their lines, computed from the related manufacturing orders. Salespeople can see whether production has started or finished without opening the manufacturing orders. It requires the sale_mrp module.

name: sale_purchase_stock_auto_cancel
summary: Adds a company setting that cancels the purchase orders created by dropship or made-to-order sales when the sale is cancelled. The option is called POs Auto Cancelation in Sales settings. Use it so purchase orders do not linger after an order is cancelled.

name: sale_purchase_stock_auto_confirm
summary: Adds a company setting that confirms the purchase orders automatically when they are created from a sale through dropship or made-to-order routes. The option is called POs Auto Validation in Sales settings. Use it to skip the manual confirmation step for those purchases.

name: sale_quotation_number
summary: Gives quotations their own number sequence, separate from confirmed sale orders. When a quotation is confirmed, the order gets the next order number and the quotation number is kept as the origin. The shared numbering option is turned off in Sales settings.

name: sale_readonly_security
summary: Adds a permission that lets users view sale orders without being able to create, edit or delete them. Turning off the Sale orders edition permission on a user makes their orders read only. Use it for people who only need to look at orders.

name: sale_require_po_doc
summary: Flags customers who require a purchase order or other sales documentation before an invoice can be created. The flag and a documentation note are carried from the customer to the order, with a documentation option on the order. Use it to avoid invoicing customers who must first send a PO.

name: sale_resource_booking
summary: Links sales with resource bookings. Products can be tied to booking types, and confirming a sale creates pending bookings. A Quote button on a booking type generates a sale order with the booked product through a wizard.

name: sale_restricted_qty
summary: Sets minimum, maximum and multiple-of quantity rules on products and product categories. Sales lines are checked against these rules and either blocked or flagged with a warning, depending on the rule. They are configured in the Qty Constraints section of the product's Sales tab.

name: sale_semaphore
summary: Shows a green, yellow or red indicator on sale lines based on how far the price sits from the product's public price, using discount thresholds set per product or category. The indicator also appears on invoice lines and reports. It makes discount policy visible while selling.

name: sale_shipping_info_helper
summary: Adds computed shipping and item amount totals (untaxed, tax and total) to sale orders, for use in reports or e-commerce. Nothing new is shown on screen by default. It depends on the delivery module.

name: sale_sourced_by_line
summary: Lets each sale order line come from a different warehouse than the order's default warehouse. One procurement group is created per warehouse used, and it works with make-to-order and dropship routes only. Use it for lines fulfilled from different sites.

name: sale_start_end_dates
summary: Adds start and end dates to sale order lines, required for products that must have dates, and default dates on the order that fill new lines. The dates are copied to the invoice lines. It is mainly a building block for rental and similar modules.

name: sale_stock_cancel_restriction
summary: Blocks cancelling a sale order when its delivery orders are done. Once a picking is validated, the cancel action is refused with a message. Use it to protect orders that have already shipped.

name: sale_stock_delivery_address
summary: Lets each sale order line go to a different delivery address, splitting deliveries as needed. Each destination can point to its own stock location, so the goods ship from the right place. Setup requires developer mode and rules on the destination locations.

name: sale_stock_delivery_state
summary: A glue module that makes the delivery status on sale orders work with the stock module, by combining sale_delivery_state with stock. Users see the same status field, now computed from deliveries. It is technical and adds no new screens.

name: sale_stock_expiry_date_on_qty_at_date_widget
summary: Shows the next expiry date in the stock availability widget on a sale order line, so a salesperson can tell the customer when stock expires. It is used with lot or serial tracked products that have expiration dates. Users need the Sales own documents permission and lot management rights.

name: sale_stock_last_date
summary: Shows the date of the last delivery on each sale order line, filled in when the related picking is validated. The field can also be filtered and grouped in the sales report. Use it to see when each line last shipped.

name: sale_stock_line_customer_ref
summary: Adds a customer reference per sale order line that carries through to stock moves, pickings and packages. Lines with the same product but different customer references are kept apart in transfers. Use it when a customer needs its own reference printed on labels.

name: sale_stock_line_sequence
summary: A glue module that makes the line order on sale orders match the line order on delivery orders, so picking lines follow the sale. Sections and notes are not counted. It is technical and adds no new screens.

name: sale_stock_partner_warehouse
summary: Sets a default warehouse on sale orders from the customer record. A company setting can instead use the shipping contact's warehouse first. If the customer has no warehouse set, the usual default warehouse applies.

name: sale_stock_picking_blocking
summary: Lets a sale be confirmed without creating its delivery, using a delivery block reason. Users in the release group lift the block later, when the delivery should be created. Customers and payment terms can set a default block reason.

name: sale_stock_picking_note
summary: Adds an internal note and a customer note for the delivery to sale orders and customer records. The notes are passed to the delivery order when it is created. Use it to brief warehouse staff or show customer comments on pickings.

name: sale_stock_picking_validation_blocking
summary: Blocks validation of a sale's delivery orders from the sale order, so stock is reserved but not shipped until approval. A Block Delivery Validation button on the order sets the block, and the Validate button disappears from the related pickings. Use it when goods must be held for sign-off.

name: sale_stock_product_recommendation
summary: Adds stock forecast information to the recommended products wizard, so a salesperson can see whether a recommended product can be delivered. It shows on draft sale orders and builds on the product recommendation module. It helps decide whether to accept each recommendation.

name: sale_stock_qty_at_date_widget_multi_warehouse
summary: Changes the availability icon on a sale line so it considers stock in every warehouse, not just the order's warehouse. The icon turns yellow when gathering stock from all warehouses would cover the demand, and red when it would not. The popover lists the stock in each warehouse.

name: sale_stock_reservation_issue_on_qty_at_date_widget
summary: Turns the availability icon on a sale line yellow when the line would sell more than the free stock today, because reserved stock from other orders is in the way. The warning appears before confirmation. It helps catch reservation clashes early.

name: sale_stock_return_request
summary: Extends supplier return requests so a return can be linked to the purchase orders it amends and to its refunds. The related sales orders are shown on the return request. It lives under the Inventory operations menu.

name: sale_stock_secondary_unit
summary: Copies the secondary unit sale data from the sale line to the stock moves when the order is confirmed, so the delivery shows quantities in the second unit too. The secondary unit is set on the product. Use it when warehouse staff pick in cases or other units.

name: sale_substate
summary: Adds configurable sub-statuses to sale orders, such as waiting for legal documents, which refine each main state. Sub-statuses are set up in the technical configuration and shown in the order header. Use it to track where an order is held within a state.

name: sale_team_payment_term
summary: Sets a payment term on sales teams, used when neither the order nor the customer has one. The priority is the term on the order first, then the customer's term, then the team's term. Use it to give a sales channel a default payment term.

name: sale_tier_validation
summary: Adds an approval process to sale orders. A user requests validation, the configured reviewers approve it, and only then can the order be confirmed. Reviews appear on a Reviews tab, and a Needs my Review filter helps approvers, while printing unvalidated quotations can optionally be blocked.

name: sale_timesheet_project_manual
summary: Lets you create the project and tasks from a draft sale order before it is confirmed, using a Generate Project or Task button. It applies to service products set to create a task or a project. Use it when planning work before the sale is final.

name: sale_transaction_form_link
summary: Adds a button on the sale order to open the online payment transactions linked to it, when there are any. Use it to check payment attempts for an order without leaving the sale. The button shows a count of transactions.

name: sale_validity_auto_cancel
summary: Automatically cancels quotations once they pass their expiry date plus a set number of days. A scheduled action runs this once a day, and it stays off until the company sets the number of days. A customer-level and order-level flag controls whether a quote is included.

name: sale_warn_option
summary: Adds standard warning options to customers and products that show during sales, such as a blocking message when selling a product. Warnings are picked from a list and set quickly on the customer's internal notes or the product's Sales tab. Sale Warnings is turned on in Sales settings.

name: sale_wishlist
summary: Adds wishlists to customers. A sales manager creates a product set of the wishlist type and assigns it to a partner, who then gets a smart button to view and create more wishlists. It is a base for e-commerce or other wishlist features.

name: sales_team_security
summary: Adds a Team documents permission for salespeople, so they see only the contacts, quotations and leads that belong to their sales team or have no team. It also keeps followers in sync on company and contact records. Users with own documents only access see just their own contacts.

name: sell_only_by_packaging
summary: Makes sale lines follow product packaging rules. Products can be restricted to selling only by packaging, and a packaging can force the quantity to round up to its size, so 3 units becomes 5 if packs are 5. Lines that break the rules are blocked. Use it for products that must be sold in full cases.

name: web_widget_product_label_section_and_note_full_label_sale
summary: A glue module that makes the full-label section and note widget work on sale order lines. It also makes invoices reuse the sale line's name when they are created from an order. It is technical and adds no new screens.

name: auth_admin_passkey
summary: Lets a system administrator log in as any user with a separate admin password stored in the server configuration file. Users and admins can be emailed when it is used, and the password can be stored encrypted. It is a server-level technical setting with no screens of its own.

name: auth_api_key
summary: Lets outside programs call Odoo's web services using an API key sent in an HTTP header instead of a password. Keys are created and managed under Technical settings in debug mode, and an option lets keys keep working for inactive users. It is a technical feature used by integrations.

name: auth_api_key_group
summary: Groups API keys together so other modules can restrict services or records to a set of keys. Grouping on its own does nothing visible to users. It is a technical building block on top of API keys.

name: auth_api_key_server_env
summary: Defines API keys in the server configuration file instead of the database. This keeps keys from carrying over when a database is copied between environments. It is a technical setting that depends on server environment configuration.

name: auth_jwt
summary: Lets developers protect web routes with JSON Web Token (JWT) login, using validators configured in Odoo for signing and audience checks. Users are identified from the token. It is a developer and integration feature with no end-user screens.

name: auth_jwt_demo
summary: A demo module for JWT login that creates a sample validator and a test route that returns the partner identified in the token. It is meant for developers testing auth_jwt, not for production use. It is technical.

name: auth_oauth_filter_by_domain
summary: Shows only the OAuth login providers whose allowed domains match the web address the user is on. Providers with no allowed domains appear on every domain. The domains are set on the OAuth Providers screen in settings.

name: auth_oauth_login_field
summary: When a user signs up through OAuth, takes the login name from the token if one is provided, so a user's login can differ from their email. It is often paired with OpenID Connect token mapping. It is a technical login behaviour with no new screens.

name: auth_oauth_multi_token
summary: Lets the same user stay logged in on several devices at once through the same OAuth account, such as Google or Odoo login. A per-user limit caps how many simultaneous connections are allowed. It is a technical login behaviour with no new screens.

name: auth_oidc
summary: Lets users sign in to Odoo through an OpenID Connect provider, such as Microsoft Azure, using the authorization code flow. Providers are set up under OAuth providers in settings, and their login buttons appear on the login page. It is a setup task for IT administrators.

name: auth_oidc_environment
summary: Reads OpenID Connect provider settings, such as client ID and secret, from the server environment file instead of the database. This keeps the credentials out of the database when it is copied. It is a technical setting that depends on server environment.

name: auth_saml
summary: Lets users sign in to Odoo through a SAML 2 identity provider, for single sign-on across company applications. Users are pre-created with their SAML details, and passwords can be turned off so they rely on SSO. Providers are configured under SAML providers in settings.

name: auth_session_timeout
summary: Logs users out automatically after a period of inactivity, two hours by default. The timeout and a list of pages to ignore are set as system parameters. It is a technical security setting.

name: auth_signup_verify_email
summary: Lets people sign up for an account without choosing a password, then sets the password on first login, so the email address has to be real. Outgoing email must be working and free sign-up must be enabled for customer accounts. Use it for customer or portal registration.

name: auth_totp_enforce
summary: Requires internal users to set up an authenticator app for two-factor login before they can reach the backend. On their next login, users are taken through a mandatory setup page with a QR code. Members of the exempt group are not forced, and portal and public users are out of scope.

name: auth_user_case_insensitive
summary: Makes user login names case insensitive, so an upper or lower case version of a login signs in the same user. Search also works with mixed case logins on databases that already had case sensitive ones. It is a technical login behaviour with no new screens.

name: base_group_subcontractor
summary: Adds a restricted user type called Subcontractors that gives backend access with only the minimum permissions, exposing just the Discuss menu. Any further permissions must be granted through customisation. Use it for outside contractors who only need to chat.

name: base_user_empty_password
summary: Adds a wizard that clears the password of selected users, so they must sign in another way, such as through single sign-on. Use it to move users off local Odoo passwords. It is a technical administration tool.

name: base_user_show_email
summary: Separates the login and email fields on the user form, labelling the first one Login and showing Email as its own field. The user list also shows the email next to the login. Use it when logins are not email addresses.

name: cross_connect_client
summary: Lets users of this Odoo instance sign in to another Odoo instance that has the cross connect server module installed. The other server is configured under Technical settings with its URL and API key. It is a technical integration.

name: cross_connect_server
summary: Lets other Odoo instances log their users into this one, through a FastAPI endpoint with an allowed group list and client API keys. Clients are set up under the FastAPI endpoints menu. It is the server side of a technical integration.

name: impersonate_login
summary: Lets an authorised user, such as support staff, log in as another user and return to their own account with one button. The chatter shows who is impersonating, messages go out under the original user, and each session is logged. Admins can block impersonation of users with settings rights.

name: password_security
summary: Sets company-wide password rules, including expiry in days, minimum length, required lowercase, uppercase, numbers and special characters, and password history. The rules apply on each user's next password change. They are configured in General Settings under the Password Policy section.

name: user_log_view
summary: Adds a smart button on a user's form that opens their authentication logs, so you can see their recent sign-ins. Use it to check when a user logged in. It is found under Settings, Users and Companies.

name: users_ldap_mail
summary: Maps the name and email from LDAP directory accounts onto Odoo users, so LDAP-logged users get the right name and email. The mapping is set on the LDAP server settings under Process Parameters. It extends the LDAP login module.

name: vault
summary: Adds an end-to-end encrypted vault for passwords and files. Encryption and decryption happen in the browser, so the server cannot read the secrets, and access to each vault is granted per user with read, create, write, share and delete rights. It requires HTTPS to work.

name: vault_share
summary: Lets users share a secret with someone outside Odoo through a link protected by a PIN. Shares can be made from a vault entry or created directly, and they are deleted when the access count runs out or the share expires. It is not meant for long-term storage of secrets.

name: base_external_dbsource
summary: Lets administrators define connections to other databases, using ODBC, Firebird, Oracle client or SQLAlchemy, for use by other modules. Connections are set up under Database Sources in the technical settings and store the connection string and password. It is a technical integration base.

name: base_external_dbsource_mssql
summary: Adds SQL Server (MSSQL) support to external database sources, connecting through SQLAlchemy. It is set up in the same place as the base database sources. It is a technical connector.

name: base_external_dbsource_mysql
summary: Adds MySQL support to external database sources, connecting through SQLAlchemy. It is set up under Database Sources in the technical settings. It is a technical connector.

name: base_external_dbsource_sqlite
summary: Adds SQLite file support to external database sources, connecting through SQLAlchemy. It is set up under Database Sources in the technical settings. It is a technical connector.

name: base_external_system
summary: A technical base for storing connection details to remote systems, with fields for host, port, username, password and private key, plus a common client interface that other modules use. Credentials are stored in plain text, so encryption has to come from another module. Systems are configured under External Systems in the technical settings.

name: base_global_discount
summary: A base module that defines global discounts, which can apply to sales or purchases, and lets customers and suppliers carry their own discount lists. On its own it adds little. The accounting or purchase global discount module is what makes it show on documents. Discounts are managed under Global Discounts in settings.

name: base_group_backend
summary: Adds two restricted Backend User groups that give access to the backend only, without the full Internal User permissions, so custom modules cannot quietly widen access. One of the groups also gives the user interface and a minimal menu. Use it for controlled back-office users.

name: base_ical
summary: Publishes read-only calendar feeds (ICS links) built from chosen Odoo records, such as events, that users can subscribe to in calendar apps. Each feed is set up with a model and an optional domain, and users enable it on their profile. Use it to show Odoo data in Nextcloud or other calendars.

name: base_import_match
summary: Lets imports detect existing records by fields other than the XML ID, such as VAT, email or name, so imported rows update the right record instead of creating duplicates. Match rules are set under Import Match in the technical settings. Use it when syncing data from other systems.

name: base_portal_type
summary: Lets administrators create groups for portal users, so customers and vendors using the portal can get different views and features. Groups in the portal type category appear on the user form for portal users. It is a technical base for portal setups.

name: base_user_effective_permissions
summary: Shows a combined view of a user's access rights and record rules for each model, with the rule conditions written out. It is useful for checking what a user can really see or change. It is opened from the user form in developer mode.

name: base_user_role
summary: Lets you group technical access rights into named roles, then assign roles to users. Roles can have start and end dates, and a user's groups are kept in line with their roles. Use it to manage many users without juggling individual groups.

name: base_user_role_activity
summary: Creates a reminder activity when a user's role assignment is close to ending, 30 days before by default. The activity is attached to the user's partner record, and it is removed if the end date changes. It builds on the user roles module.

name: base_user_role_company
summary: Makes a role apply only when the selected companies allow it. A company-specific role is active only if it is valid for every company currently selected, and the user's groups update when the company selection changes. It is set on the user's role lines.

name: base_user_role_history
summary: Keeps a log of every change to a user's roles, recording what changed, who made the change, and the old and new dates. A smart button on the user form opens the history. Use it to audit role changes.

name: base_user_role_profile
summary: Adds profiles on top of user roles, so a user can switch between permission sets from the top bar. Each role can be linked to a profile, and roles without a profile always apply. Use it to simplify menus or limit editing in certain work modes.

name: server_action_navigate
summary: Adds a Navigate option to server actions on list views, so you can jump from a selection of records to the related records through a field, such as from sale orders to the products on them. It is a technical tool for moving between linked data quickly.
